batch: C03c.2 authenticated operating-point rate initialization and stationary transport provenance

environment.timeout_scope: Harness timeout, not a measured performance acceptance bound.

source_hash_scope: Hashes identify the committed compiled source_revision. Native development runs retain their separate source states. Qualification/plan documentation is uncommitted while this record is captured.

root_cause.static_rate: The constant-bias OP has approximately 2e-17 A of floating-point KCL remainder. Dividing this by the tiny reverse-charge derivative created coordinate rates of order 1e13 V/s.
root_cause.false_arrival: An unconditional time-zero transport event subsequently reprojected the constant equilibrium at one delay, reproducing the same problem even after the initial rate correction.
root_cause.diagnostic_scope: Development traces identified the cause; quoted magnitudes are diagnostic observations, not independent simulator comparisons.

implementation.rate_contract: Only an accepted unconstrained OP with unchanged source-side values and matching nodal/junction conditioning may supply static balance to the storage-row rate RHS. Prescribed source slopes and explicit time derivatives remain in the rate equations.
implementation.excluded_paths: UIC or missing certificate, released ICs, changed conditioning, real authored source jumps, and transmission-line history without a separate OP/history certificate.
implementation.event_contract: Only structurally constant deterministic independent forcing establishes stationary prehistory and omits the synthetic time-zero GP event. Sampled/nonconstant/RF/noise forcing retains conservative provenance.
implementation.numerical_invariants: No capacitance cutoff, blanket small-residual suppression, widened current/voltage/charge tolerance, or changed device law. Original charge, rank, differentiated rate, finite KCL and flux audits remain.

coverage.unit_scope: Broad transient run had 565 passes, one new fixture failure and one existing diagnostic ignore. All three corrected contract tests then passed; two overlap previous passes. Thus 566 distinct selected cases have successful outcomes, not 568, and no single full final-tree library run is claimed.
coverage.native_integration_scope: 74 distinct selected integration tests passed across the completed BJT target (10), corrected resource target (4), and final five-target run (60). One required driven regression remains ignored in normal runs and fails explicitly.
coverage.static_positive_gate: All three dialects and both polarities preserve private high-injection constant bias through 2.5 ns with actual RB/RC/RE, RELTOL=1e-7, and original lead-current tolerance 1e-12 A + 1e-5 * abs(reference).
coverage.guard_cases: Roundoff versus real tiny excitation, retained voltage-source slope and capacitor current, original inductor-voltage audit, missing/changed OP contracts and released ICs, sub-tolerance authored source jump, nonstationary source provenance.
coverage.resource_gate: Both constant-history and retained-startup-event fixtures succeed at the calculated exact live/copy budget and refuse a one-byte-insufficient budget; aggregate, compression, checkpoint schedule, restore and engine reuse checks remain.
coverage.wasm_scope: 21 tests passed in an optimized headless Chrome dedicated worker on the committed source; one required regression ignored. Enabling veriloga-wasm-jit does not qualify external model/JIT evaluation.
